title.narrative: National Cleaner Production Programme (NCPP): Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: The Republic of Moldova is home to a population of 3.6 million inhabitants, with a per capita gross national income of USD1,560 in 2 009. It ranked lowest in terms of Human Development Index among European countries, and is facing serious challenges in regard to meeting the Millennium Development Goals, including in regards to water, sanitation and energy. Overseas remittances have come to dominate the economy at large, and were in 2009 equal twice the contribution of industry and triple the contribution of agriculture. Once flourishing agriculture and agribusiness, including in particular wine, have dwarfed since independence after the collapse of the Soviet Union. UNIDO with funding support from the Government of the Czech Republic implemented the preparatory stage for the establishment and operation of a National Cleaner Production Programme (NCPP) in the Republic of Moldova since mid 2009. This included training of national experts, in plant assessments in five companies, institutional capacity building and review of past Cleaner Production (CP) experiences and achievements.
